symptoms.symptom: Beeping at the end of the cycle

causes.label: This is normal. The dishwasher will beep twice at the end of the cycle.
remedies: To turn off the double beep indicator (or re-activate it if it was previously turned off), press the HEATED DRY pad 5 times within 3 seconds.
A triple beep will sound to indicate the end-of-cycle beep option has been turned on or off.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "This is normal. The dishwasher will beep twice at the end of the cycle."

causes.label: Low inlet water temperature
remedies: Make sure inlet water temperature is correct (see page 8).
Turn on the hot water faucet nearest the dishwasher; let run until the water temperature stops rising.
Then start the dishwasher and turn off the faucet.
This ensures the entering water is hot.
Try not to use the dishwasher when hot water is being used elsewhere in the house; for example, when doing laundry or when a family member is using the shower.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Low inlet water temperature"

symptoms.symptom: Spots and filming on glasses and flatware

causes.label: Overloading the dishwasher
remedies: Load dishwasher as shown in the Loading Place Settings section.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 17: "Overloading the dishwasher"

causes.label: Improper loading
remedies: Make sure detergent is fresh.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 17: "Improper loading"

causes.label: Too little detergent
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 17: "Too little detergent"

causes.label: Combination of soft water and too much detergent
remedies: This is called etching and is permanent.
To prevent this from happening, use less detergent if you have soft water.
Wash glassware in the shortest cycle that will get them clean.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 17: "Combination of soft water and too much detergent"

causes.label: Water temperature entering the dishwasher exceeds 150°F
remedies: This could be etching.
Lower the water heater temperature.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 17: "Water temperature entering the dishwasher exceeds 150°F"

causes.label: Correct detergent wasn’t used
remedies: Use only automatic dishwasher detergents to avoid sudsing.
Cascade® and Electrasol® Automatic Dishwashing Detergents have been approved for use in all GE dishwashers.
To remove suds from the tub, open the dishwasher and let suds dissipate.
Close and latch the dishwasher door.
Pump out water by touching the START/RESET pad once; then 30 seconds later, touch the START/RESET pad again.
Repeat if necessary.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 17: "Correct detergent wasn’t used"

causes.label: Rinse agent was spilled
remedies: Always wipe up rinse agent spills immediately.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 17: "Rinse agent was spilled"

causes.label: Dishes are blocking the detergent cup
remedies: Reposition the dishes, so the water from the lower spray arm can flush the detergent cup.
See pages 13 and 14.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 17: "Dishes are blocking the detergent cup"

causes.label: Cap not tightened after filling the dispenser
remedies: Use a turkey baster to remove as much water as possible from the SmartDispense™ dispenser and refill it as normal.
Be sure to tighten the cap fully to prevent water from entering the dispenser.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 17: "Cap not tightened after filling the dispenser"

symptoms.symptom: Black or gray marks on dishes

causes.label: Aluminum utensils have rubbed against dishes
remedies: Remove marks with a mild, abrasive cleaner.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 17: "Aluminum utensils have rubbed against dishes"

causes.label: Low inlet water temperature
remedies: Make sure inlet water temperature is at least 120°F.
Select HEATED DRY.
Use PRE-WASH or ADDED HEAT options.
Select a higher cycle, such as ANTI-BACTERIA or COOKWARE.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 17: "Low inlet water temperature"

causes.label: Rinse agent dispenser is empty
remedies: Check the rinse agent dispenser and fill as required.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 17: "Rinse agent dispenser is empty"

causes.label: Fuse is blown or circuit breaker is tripped
remedies: Replace fuse or reset circuit breaker.
Remove any other appliances from the circuit.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Fuse is blown or circuit breaker is tripped"

causes.label: Power is turned off
remedies: In some installations, the power to the dishwasher is provided through a wall switch, often located next to the disposer switch.
Make sure it is on.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Power is turned off"

causes.label: Control panel is locked
remedies: Unlock control panel.
See page 6.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Control panel is locked"

causes.label: Control panel needs to be rebooted
remedies: Turn off power to the dishwasher (circuit breaker or wall switch) for 30 seconds; then turn back on.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Control panel needs to be rebooted"

symptoms.symptom: Control panel lights go off when you’re setting controls

causes.label: Time too long between touching of selected pads
remedies: Each pad must be touched within 5 minutes of the others.
To relight, touch any pad again, or unlock and relatch door.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Time too long between touching of selected pads"

symptoms.symptom: Water standing in the bottom of the tub

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: A small amount of clean water around the outlet on the tub bottom at the back of the tub keeps the pump seal lubricated.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "This is normal"

symptoms.symptom: Water won’t pump out of the tub

causes.label: Drain is clogged
remedies: If you have an air gap, clean it.
See page 15.
If the dishwasher drains into a disposer, run disposer clear.
Check to see if your kitchen sink is draining well.
If not, you may need a plumber.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Drain is clogged"

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: Warm, moist air comes through the vent by the door latch during drying and when water is being pumped out.
This is necessary for drying.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "This is normal"

symptoms.symptom: Sanitized light does not illuminate at the end of the cycle

causes.label: The door was opened and the cycle was interrupted during or after the main wash portion
remedies: Do not interrupt the cycle anytime during or after main wash.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "The door was opened and the cycle was interrupted during or after the main wash portion"

causes.label: Rattling dishes when the spray arm rotates
remedies: Make sure dishes are properly loaded.
See the Loading the dishwasher racks section.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Rattling dishes when the spray arm rotates"
